summary: The pooled density g is measurable, nonnegative, bounded above by kappa and hence by 1, has mass W, and has first moment equal to the selected weighted sum. This proves W is in the admissible mass range and places every independently selected weighted Minkowski point in the mass-W metronoid. Finite-index null-set, integrability, boundary-mass, and zero-weight cases are all handled correctly.
